# Hard constraints for the Mac env. Pass via -c to EVERY pip install:
#     .venv/bin/pip install -c env/constraints-mac.txt <pkg>
#
# numpy  : the anchor. numba 0.60 accepts >=1.22,<2.1; librosa 0.10.2 prefers 1.x.
#          If anything ever hard-requires numpy>=2, migrate the WHOLE env
#          (numpy 2.1.x + numba 0.61 + librosa 0.11) — never mix.
# scipy  : capped by audiomentations 0.37.0 (requires scipy<1.13). Pinned so the
#          resolved version is a decision, not an accident.
numpy==1.26.4
scipy==1.12.0
